set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 8. Decide final artifact names, move archive-specific representation code into interop, scientific transform execution out of archive core, and dataset archive/representation dispatch into interop or runtime. Update build edges and documentation and add executable production-source import and build-edge guards in this phase. Acceptance: archive core has no DCT/Haar/HRBF/transport/BOLDZip reconstruction; latent core has no HDF5/Zarr paths, object keys, byte codecs, or checksums; dataset main sources import neither scalafim.archive nor scalafim.latent and expose no LNA/Zarr/representation dispatch; DatasetError no longer exposes archive/latent cases unless a documented unreleased-API exception applies; the DAG is acyclic; JVM/JS gates and the frozen corpus pass. Stop before manifest work if any cycle, hidden compatibility import, or unrecorded ownership exception remains.
